description: One narrative entry against a task, an accident investigation or a discipline record: who wrote it, when, in what language, and whether they typed it or spoke it. ONE CHILD TABLE FOR THREE PARENTS, because it is one act — somebody putting an account of what happened into a record — and three near-identical tables would drift the first time one of them grew a column. Entries are APPENDED, never edited: an investigation that spans four days is four entries, and rewriting Monday's account on Thursday is how a contemporaneous record stops being one.

fields.description: What kind of entry this is. `Finding` and `Corrective Action` exist because an accident investigation's entries are not all the same thing and a legal reader needs to tell them apart without reading every one; `Conversation` is what a discipline record's account of a meeting is.
fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Note
Finding
Corrective Action
Conversation
Witness Statement
Root Cause

fields.description: The Employee who wrote it. A Data field rather than a Link for the reason Farm Task.assigned_to is one: Frappe HR is not a dependency of this app, and a Link would make this table fail to migrate on a site without it.
fields.label: Author

fields.description: When it was written. STAMPED AT APPEND and never moved — an investigation's value in a hearing is that each entry says when somebody knew what.
fields.label: Written At

fields.description: Whether somebody typed this or spoke it. IT MATTERS TO A READER: a transcription is a machine's reading of speech and carries the errors speech recognition makes, and a hearing that treats it as a verbatim quote is treating it as something it is not.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The language this was written or spoken in, as an ISO code — 'en', 'es'. Recorded rather than assumed: a Spanish account transcribed by a Spanish recogniser and then read by an English-speaking reviewer is a translation waiting to happen, and one that nobody knows is needed is the worse case.
fields.label: Source Language

fields.description: The recording this was transcribed from, where there was one. THE AUDIO IS KEPT: a transcription is evidence about the recording, and a record that discarded the original would have no way to answer a challenge to the wording.
fields.label: Audio File

fields.description: The account itself, at whatever length it takes. A `Text` and not a `Small Text` deliberately — 'describe what happened' is the question an OSHA investigation and a discipline meeting both ask, and a field that runs out of room teaches people to answer it in note form.
fields.label: Narrative

name: Task Note
